I’m sorry—I don’t have direct access to live weather feeds right now, so I can’t give you the exact temperature at this moment in Riga.  

If you’d like up‑to‑date information, you might try one of the following:

| Option | How to use |
|--------|------------|
| **Weather websites** (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather) | Just type “Riga” into the search bar. |
| **Smartphone apps** (Apple Weather, Google Assistant, Siri) | Ask your device directly (“What’s the temperature in Riga?”). |
| **OpenWeatherMap API** | If you’re comfortable coding, sign up for a free key and call `https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather?q=Riga&units=metric&appid=<YOUR_KEY>` – the JSON will include `"main":{"temp":…}`. |

Let me know if you'd like help setting up an automated query or interpreting the results!
